QuestInfo.name: About the City Center
QuestInfo.0: #bEdea#k has a mission for you. Meet her in the #bCommander Barracks#k.
QuestInfo.1: You need to dig up information on the city center. Find #bEurenth#k in #bEurenth's Hut#k.
QuestInfo.2: You found Eurenth, but he does not look happy to see you.

0.0: I hear you were quite helpful in the development of the Blue Dragon Cannon.\r\n
0.1: The cannon has been a boon in our efforts to counterattack and disrupt our enemy's supply lines. I suspect that their morale, too, has taken a hit.\r\n
0.2: It is time for us to reclaim the city center. I want you to take point in gathering intelligence for our next move.\r\n

yes.0: There's an old man named #bEurenth#k who lives beyond the Twisted Forest Border. Make contact with him and find out what he knows about the region.\r\n
yes.1: He is ill-tempered, but he was once known as a great sage. I'm certain he holds the key to our campaign.\r\n
yes.2: It won't be easy to convince him to work with us, but you must try. Good luck.\r\n#r(You will automatically move to the relevant field.)#k

no.0: It looks like I have no choice.\r\n

1.0: And who are you? You don't look like any Nova I've seen, but you don't look like one of them foreigners, either.\r\n

yes.0: Hmph. Those arrogant eyes... That crooked grin... Haven't I seen your fool face somewhere before?\r\n
yes.1: Ah, forget it. You're bad news, I can tell. Shoo! Leave me alone!\r\n
